purpose: Define a deterministic, reviewable source-WebM to Telegram-native MP4 preparation lane without changing source files or authorizing provider writes.

toolchain_lock.rule: The exact conversion toolchain must be recorded before outputs are accepted. Outputs produced by an unrecorded toolchain are not release candidates.

probe_gate.rule: Probe exact bytes from the pinned source commit. Do not infer codec, dimensions, duration, frame rate or audio presence from extension, poster or browser playback.

output_policy.metadata_policy: strip nonessential source metadata; preserve no customer/private metadata by default
output_policy.geometry_policy: preserve source aspect ratio and orientation; never upscale; if scaling is required for compatibility or size, scale down only and produce even dimensions
output_policy.frame_rate_policy: preserve source timing/frame rate unless the exact source probe demonstrates a compatibility reason to change it; any change must be recorded per output

audio_policy.if_source_has_no_audio: produce no audio stream; never synthesize silence or music
audio_policy.if_source_has_audio: encode a single AAC-LC track only after exact source audio is reviewed; do not invent, replace or mix audio

size_policy.release_gate: output byte size must be measured and recorded; being below the hard limit is necessary but not sufficient

acceptance_gates: source bytes match the pinned source Git blob and frozen source SHA-256
conversion command argv is frozen and contains no unreviewed filters
output is MP4 with H.264 video and yuv420p pixel format
output dimensions are positive even integers and no larger than source dimensions unless an explicit reviewed exception exists
output aspect ratio is materially preserved
output duration does not materially diverge from source duration
audio policy matches exact source audio state
output byte size is below the reviewed Telegram hard limit
canonical editorial media identity remains unchanged, especially v04 = meringue roll
no provider upload/send is performed by conversion acceptance
rollout_rule: Conversion acceptance creates a transport-ready local artifact only. It does not authorize sendVideo, scheduling, posting, pinning, cross-posting or any other provider mutation.
